item.content:encoded:
The National Football League (NFL) is inviting talented professionals to explore its current employment opportunities across football operations, marketing, communications, digital media, technology, finance, events, partnerships, human resources, and other specialized areas. With 43 jobs currently listed, these openings provide opportunities for professionals with different backgrounds and levels of expertise to pursue careers within one of the world’s most prominent sports and entertainment organizations.

About the National Football League

The National Football League is a global sports and entertainment organization built around professional American football. Beyond the games played on the field, the NFL operates across a wide range of disciplines, including media production, digital content, marketing, partnerships, communications, technology, finance, events, football operations, and community engagement.

According to the NFL careers announcement, employment opportunities are available not only within the League itself but also across its 32 NFL teams, the League office in New York City, NFL Films in Mount Laurel, New Jersey, NFL Media in Inglewood, California, and international offices.

The organization describes its employees as stewards of the game and emphasizes teamwork, innovation, responsibility, character, and the role football plays in bringing people and communities together.

For professionals interested in working at the intersection of sports, entertainment, media, communications, marketing, technology, business, and digital content, the NFL’s current vacancies offer a broad range of career possibilities.

NFL Current Job Openings

The NFL careers page currently lists 43 available positions spanning several departments and locations. The vacancies range from senior leadership positions to seasonal, part-time, coordinator, associate, and specialist roles.

The following are some of the opportunities currently listed.

1. Brand and Partnership Management

The Brand & Partnership Management division includes roles focused on developing the NFL brand, engaging fans, managing partnerships, supporting players, and delivering marketing initiatives.

Global Brand & Consumer Marketing

Senior Director, Creative — New York, United States

This senior creative leadership position sits within Global Brand & Consumer Marketing. It is particularly relevant to experienced professionals with backgrounds in creative strategy, brand development, advertising, marketing communications, and creative leadership.

Marketing Science & Strategy

Director, Fan Engagement Marketing – International Club CRM & Performance Marketing — New York, United States

This role focuses on fan engagement, customer relationship management, performance marketing, and international club audiences.

Professionals with experience in marketing strategy, digital marketing, customer engagement, analytics, CRM, or international marketing may find this area particularly relevant.

Player Engagement – Brand & Partnership Management

Senior Manager, Player Engagement — New York, United States

This position focuses on player engagement within the broader brand and partnership function. It may appeal to experienced professionals with backgrounds in partnerships, stakeholder engagement, brand management, sports business, or related fields.

Social & Influencer Marketing

The NFL is also recruiting for several production and digital-content positions based in Inglewood, California.

Current listings include:

  • Seasonal Bilingual Video Editor, Global Creative Marketing
  • Seasonal Live Content Correspondents Production Coordinator
  • Seasonal Video Editor, Global Creative Marketing

These positions are particularly relevant to professionals interested in video production, editing, social media content, live content, digital storytelling, and sports entertainment.

Sponsorship & Partnership Relations

The NFL also has opportunities within sponsorship and partnership development, including:

  • Manager, Global Partnerships Strategy — New York
  • Manager, Sponsorship New Business — New York

These roles are suited to professionals with relevant experience in business development, sponsorship, strategic partnerships, commercial relationships, sales, or marketing.

2. International Opportunities

The NFL’s career opportunities extend beyond the United States.

International Licensing

Seasonal FAST Video Systems Operator — Inglewood, California

This role is associated with international licensing and focuses on video systems operations.

NFL London / International Operations

Senior Manager, Commercial Accounts (France) — Paris, France

This international position demonstrates the NFL’s expanding commercial and business operations outside the United States.

The position is based in Paris, France, and is particularly relevant to experienced professionals with commercial account management, business development, partnership, or related experience.

3. Accounting and Finance

The League Office also has opportunities in accounting and financial management.

Current openings include:

  • Coordinator, Accounting – Global Media — Inglewood, California
  • Manager, Finance – League Corporate — New York
  • Senior Coordinator, Finance – Global Partnerships — New York

These roles provide opportunities for professionals with accounting, finance, financial analysis, budgeting, reporting, corporate finance, or partnership-finance experience.

4. Communications and Public Affairs

For communication professionals, one of the notable vacancies is:

Director, Communications – Flag Football — New York, United States

This position falls under Communications & Public Affairs at the League Office.

A communications-focused position within the NFL can be particularly relevant for professionals experienced in areas such as:

  • Corporate communications
  • Public relations
  • Media relations
  • Strategic communications
  • Content development
  • Stakeholder communications
  • Sports communications
  • Public affairs
  • Brand communications

5. Events

The NFL’s events function plays an important role in delivering major sporting and entertainment experiences.

Current event-related positions include:

  • Director, Event Location Strategy — New York
  • Senior Manager, Global Event Production — New York

These roles are relevant to professionals with backgrounds in event strategy, event management, production, venue planning, large-scale events, entertainment, or sports operations.

Working in NFL events can involve the planning and execution of high-profile experiences associated with the League’s global sporting and entertainment activities.

6. Football Operations

The NFL also has positions directly connected to football development and operations.

Current openings include:

  • Director, Professional & Adult Competitive Flag Football — New York
  • Manager, Flag Football — New York

These positions are especially relevant to professionals with expertise or experience in football administration, sports management, program development, competition management, or related areas.

The presence of flag football-related positions also reflects the NFL’s broader work around the development and growth of the sport.

7. Human Resources

The League Office currently lists:

Associate, HR Operations (External Agency Staff) — New York

This opportunity is associated with human resources operations and may suit professionals with relevant HR administration, employee services, operations, or organizational support experience.

8. Information Technology

The NFL is also hiring within technology infrastructure.

Director, Stadium Network Architecture — Mount Laurel, New Jersey

This senior technology role is focused on stadium network architecture and is relevant to experienced information technology and network infrastructure professionals.

Candidates interested in this area would typically need substantial technical expertise and experience appropriate to a director-level position.

9. Social Responsibility

The NFL’s Social Responsibility division currently includes:

Administrative Assistant (External Agency Staff) — New York

This position offers an opportunity to contribute administrative and organizational support within an area associated with the NFL’s broader social responsibility activities.

10. NFL Enterprises

NFL Enterprises includes several commercial, digital, and media functions.

Club Business Development

Associate, Super Bowl Suite Sales & Service (External Agency Staff) — New York

This position focuses on sales and service associated with Super Bowl suites and is relevant to candidates interested in premium hospitality, sales, customer service, sports business, and commercial operations.

Digital Media Content

The NFL currently lists several positions in digital media content, including:

  • Digital Content Associate (External Agency Staff) — Inglewood, California
  • Part-Time Media Design Group Designer/Animator — Inglewood, California
  • Seasonal Graphics Designer/Animator — Inglewood, California
  • Seasonal Live Digital Media Specialist 2 — Inglewood, California
  • Seasonal Part-Time Broadcast Audio 1 — Inglewood, California
  • Seasonal Part-Time Lighting Director — Inglewood, California
  • Seasonal Part-Time Utility — Inglewood, California
  • Seasonal Part-Time V1/Shading Operator — Inglewood, California
  • Seasonal Vertical Video Editor — Inglewood, California

These vacancies make the NFL’s current recruitment particularly interesting for people working in digital media, graphic design, animation, video editing, broadcast production, audio, lighting, live production, and visual content creation.

For creative professionals, the availability of graphics, animation, video editing, and digital content positions could provide opportunities to apply creative and technical skills within a major international sports-media environment.

11. Digital Media Technology

The NFL also has vacancies within digital media technology.

Current positions include:

  • Director, Broadcast Engineering — Inglewood, California
  • Seasonal Ad Operations Coordinator — Inglewood, California
  • Seasonal Customer Support Operations Coordinator — Inglewood, California
  • Seasonal Part-Time TOC Operator — Inglewood, California
  • Seasonal Product Operations Coordinator — Inglewood, California

These positions demonstrate the extensive technical infrastructure required to deliver sports content and digital experiences to audiences.

Candidates with experience in broadcasting, technology operations, advertising operations, customer support, product operations, or media technology may find opportunities that match their professional background.

12. NFL.com Mobile

The NFL also has a senior product and design opportunity:

VP, Product & Design — Inglewood, California

This leadership position is aimed at highly experienced professionals working in product management, digital product development, user experience, design, technology, and related areas.

13. Strategy and Business Intelligence

Senior Manager, International Data & Strategy — New York

This position falls under Strategy & Business Intelligence and is focused on international data and strategic business functions.

The opportunity may be relevant to professionals with backgrounds in:

  • Business strategy
  • Data analysis
  • Business intelligence
  • International markets
  • Strategic planning
  • Market research
  • Commercial analytics

14. NFL Films

The NFL Films office in Mount Laurel, New Jersey, also has several seasonal opportunities.

Current openings include:

  • Seasonal Avid/Interplay Media Specialist
  • Seasonal Football Operations Coordinator
  • Seasonal Production Coordinator II
  • Seasonal Project Coordinator
  • Seasonal Rights & Clearances Coordinator

These positions can be particularly relevant to candidates interested in sports media production, film and television production, media asset management, football operations, project coordination, and rights management.

The Avid/Interplay Media Specialist role, for example, is particularly relevant to professionals familiar with media production systems and workflows.

Why Consider a Career With the NFL?

A career with the NFL can provide exposure to a large-scale sports, entertainment, media, and business environment.

The organization’s current vacancies demonstrate that working for the NFL is not limited to athletes, coaches, or football specialists. The League requires professionals across a wide range of disciplines to operate its business and deliver experiences to fans.

Depending on the role, employees can work in areas such as:

  1. Marketing and brand management
  2. Corporate communications
  3. Digital marketing
  4. Social media
  5. Graphic design
  6. Animation
  7. Video production
  8. Broadcast engineering
  9. Finance and accounting
  10. Human resources
  11. Information technology
  12. Events and production
  13. Football operations
  14. Partnerships and sponsorships
  15. Business development
  16. Data and strategy
  17. Product and digital design
  18. Media production
  19. Audio and lighting
  20. Content operations

This makes the NFL careers portal potentially valuable for both specialized professionals and individuals looking to build careers in the broader sports and entertainment industry.

Locations of Current NFL Jobs

The vacancies listed in the supplied opportunity information are distributed across several locations.

United States

A significant number of positions are based in:

  • New York, New York
  • Inglewood, California
  • Mount Laurel, New Jersey

These locations correspond to different NFL business, media, League Office, and production functions.

France

The NFL also has an international opening in:

  • Paris, France

The international listing highlights the organization’s presence and commercial activities beyond the United States.

Who Should Consider Applying?

Because the NFL has vacancies across many departments, the ideal candidate depends heavily on the individual position.

Applicants should carefully review the specific requirements attached to each vacancy before submitting an application.

Potentially relevant professional backgrounds include:

  • Marketing and communications
  • Digital marketing
  • Social media management
  • Content creation
  • Graphic design
  • Video editing
  • Animation
  • Photography and media production
  • Broadcast production
  • Finance and accounting
  • Human resources
  • Information technology
  • Network architecture
  • Business development
  • Partnerships and sponsorships
  • Event management
  • Football and sports operations
  • Data analysis and business intelligence
  • Product management
  • UX and digital design
  • Project coordination
  • Media rights and clearances

Because the vacancies range from associate and coordinator positions to senior manager, director, and vice-president roles, applicants should select positions that correspond to their education, professional experience, technical skills, and career level.

How to Apply for NFL Jobs

Interested applicants should review the individual job descriptions carefully rather than applying indiscriminately to every available vacancy.

A strong application should generally begin by identifying positions that closely match the candidate’s professional background.

Applicants should then:

  1. Review the job description carefully
    Examine the responsibilities, qualifications, experience requirements, location, employment type, and any technical or professional requirements.
  2. Assess your suitability
    Compare your education, work experience, technical abilities, and professional achievements with the requirements listed for the specific position.
  3. Prepare an updated CV or resume
    Highlight experience that directly relates to the position. For creative, communications, media, technology, or marketing roles, relevant portfolios or examples of previous work can also strengthen an application where requested.
  4. Customize your application
    Avoid submitting the same generic application for every role. Emphasize the specific skills and experiences that make you suitable for the position.
  5. Check the location and working arrangement
    Many of the listed positions are based in the United States, while at least one current opportunity is based in France. Candidates should confirm whether they can meet the location and employment requirements of their preferred role.
  6. Submit through the official NFL careers platform
    Each vacancy has its own application page, so applicants should use the relevant job listing when applying.

APPLY HERE

Important Note About Deadlines

Deadline: No single application deadline is provided in the supplied NFL careers listing.

These are ongoing job vacancies rather than a single scholarship, fellowship, grant, or competition with one common closing date. Individual vacancies may be removed, updated, or closed as recruitment progresses.

Applicants are therefore encouraged to apply as soon as possible to positions that match their qualifications and to check the individual vacancy page for the latest application status.

How to Find the Most Suitable NFL Vacancy

With dozens of positions available, applicants can save time by filtering opportunities according to their professional interests.

For example:

  • Communications professionals can explore Communications & Public Affairs.
  • Digital marketers can examine Brand & Consumer Marketing, Social & Influencer Marketing, and Digital Media Content.
  • Graphic designers and animators can look at Media Design Group, Graphics Designer/Animator, and related creative positions.
  • Video editors can consider the Video Editor and Vertical Video Editor opportunities.
  • Technology professionals can explore Broadcast Engineering, Stadium Network Architecture, and Digital Media Technology.
  • Finance professionals can explore Accounting & Finance.
  • Event professionals can consider Global Event Production and Event Location Strategy.
  • Business development professionals can explore Club Business Development and Partnerships.
  • Data professionals can examine Strategy & Business Intelligence.
  • Media production professionals can explore NFL Films.
  • Sports professionals can consider Football Operations and Flag Football positions.

This approach can make the NFL careers portal more manageable and help applicants focus on opportunities that align with their strongest qualifications.

Visit HERE to learn more NFL Careers.

Final Thoughts

The current NFL recruitment drive presents a broad selection of career opportunities across the sports, entertainment, media, marketing, technology, business, and corporate sectors. With 43 positions listed, the opportunities extend well beyond traditional football-related careers and include roles for creative professionals, communications specialists, marketers, technologists, finance professionals, event specialists, media producers, business strategists, and sports administrators.

For professionals seeking to work within a globally recognized sports organization, the NFL can offer an opportunity to contribute to the delivery of major sporting events, digital experiences, media productions, fan engagement initiatives, commercial partnerships, and football operations.

Interested candidates should carefully review the requirements of each position, ensure that their application accurately demonstrates their relevant qualifications and experience, and submit applications through the appropriate official vacancy page. Since the supplied listing does not specify one common deadline, applicants should avoid unnecessary delays and check their preferred vacancy for its current status.
